```{r table 2, echo=FALSE}
table_s2 <- ourdata |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to = "Variable",
               values_to = "Missing_N") |>
  mutate(
    Total_N = nrow(ourdata),
    Missing_Pct = round(100 * Missing_N / Total_N, 1)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Missing_Pct))

kable(
  table_s2,
  caption = "Missing Data Summary for All Variables",
  col.names = c("Variable", "Missing (n)", "Total N", "Missing (%)"),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
)
```

```{r figure s1, fig.cap="Correlation among Numeric Variables (Left) and Association among Categorical Variables (Right)", fig.width=10, fig.height=5, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Correlation
# All numerical variables
num_vars <- clean_data |>
  select(where(is.numeric))

cor_mat <- cor(num_vars, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
p_corr <- ggcorrplot(
  cor_mat,
  hc.order = FALSE,        
  type = "lower",          
  lab = TRUE,              
  lab_size = 3,
  colors = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[c(1,5,9)],  
  outline.col = "white",
  tl.col = "black")

# All categorical variables: Cramer's V Heatmap
cat_vars <- clean_data |>
  select(where(~ !is.numeric(.x))) |>       
  select(-Diabetes)

cramer_matrix <- sapply(cat_vars, function(x)
  sapply(cat_vars, function(y) CramerV(table(x, y))))
cramer_matrix <- round(cramer_matrix, 3)
rownames(cramer_matrix) <- colnames(cramer_matrix) <- names(cat_vars)

cramer_df <- melt(cramer_matrix, varnames = c("Var1", "Var2"), value.name = "value")

p_cramer <- ggplot(cramer_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = brewer.pal(9, "Blues"),
                       limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "Cramér's V") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

(p_corr | p_cramer) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```

```{r table 3, echo=FALSE}
# Compute VIFs
vif_df <- vif(mod) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") |>
  rename(
    GVIF = GVIF,
    Df = Df,
    `GVIF^(1/(2*Df))` = `GVIF^(1/(2*Df))`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GVIF = round(GVIF, 3),
    `GVIF^(1/(2*Df))` = round(`GVIF^(1/(2*Df))`, 3)
  )

kable(
  vif_df,
  caption = "Variance Inflation Factors (VIF)",
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
)
```

```{r table 4, echo=FALSE}
# check smoke
smoking_table <- clean_data |>
  group_by(SmokeStatus) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `Mean Age` = round(mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `Median Age` = round(median(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `Diabetes Prevalence (%)` = round(mean(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    `Mean Age among Diabetics` = round(mean(Age[Diabetes == "Yes"], na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  )

kable(smoking_table, 
      caption = "Characteristics by Smoking Status",
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
```
